data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD3: Migrator emits reminder to git add sentinel if .claude/ gitignored (implementation)

## Implementation Notes
Modify plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh (created by S2 / story 6748-7ceb-1383-4ce5).

After the sentinel file is created (the line that writes `.claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated`), add a gitignore check block:

```bash
# ── Gitignore reminder ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# If .claude/ is gitignored, the sentinel won't be committed automatically.
# Remind the operator to force-add it.
_sentinel_path="$_git_root/.claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated"
if git -C "$_git_root" check-ignore -q "$_sentinel_path" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "REMINDER: The migration sentinel is gitignored. Run: git add -f .claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated" >&2
fi
```

Key constraints:
- Must NOT emit reminder when `.claude/` is not gitignored
- Must emit to stderr (not stdout) — the migrator's stdout is reserved for structural output
- The `git check-ignore -q` call must be guarded so failure (non-git context) does not abort the migrator (use `|| true` or `2>/dev/null`)
- Reminder text must include "git add" and reference the sentinel path

## TDD Requirement
This task makes the RED tests from Task 3 turn GREEN. After adding the reminder block:
- `bash tests/scripts/test-migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh` must pass (exit 0, FAILED: 0)
- Specifically: test_migrator_emits_gitignore_reminder_when_claude_gitignored and test_migrator_no_reminder_when_not_gitignored

Remove RED markers from .test-index for the two gitignore reminder test functions after the tests go GREEN.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0\b'
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(bash plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && eval "$LINT_CMD"
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(bash plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && eval "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD"
- [ ] Reminder emitted to stderr when .claude/ is gitignored
  Verify: _tmp=$(mktemp -d) && git -C "$_tmp" init -q && mkdir -p "$_tmp/.claude" && echo '.claude/' > "$_tmp/.gitignore" && echo 'merge.strategy=direct' > "$_tmp/.claude/dso-config.conf" && stderr=$(cd "$_tmp" && bash "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh" 2>&1 1>/dev/null); rm -rf "$_tmp"; echo "$stderr" | grep -q "git add"
- [ ] No reminder when .claude/ is NOT gitignored
  Verify: _tmp=$(mktemp -d) && git -C "$_tmp" init -q && mkdir -p "$_tmp/.claude" && echo 'merge.strategy=direct' > "$_tmp/.claude/dso-config.conf" && stderr=$(cd "$_tmp" && bash "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh" 2>&1 1>/dev/null); rm -rf "$_tmp"; ! echo "$stderr" | grep -q "REMINDER:"
- [ ] Reminder outputs to stderr not stdout
  Verify: _tmp=$(mktemp -d) && git -C "$_tmp" init -q && mkdir -p "$_tmp/.claude" && echo '.claude/' > "$_tmp/.gitignore" && echo 'merge.strategy=direct' > "$_tmp/.claude/dso-config.conf" && stdout=$(cd "$_tmp" && bash "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh" 2>/dev/null); rm -rf "$_tmp"; ! echo "$stdout" | grep -q "REMINDER:"
- [ ] RED markers removed from .test-index for gitignore reminder test functions
  Verify: ! grep -q '\[test_migrator.*gitignore\|test_migrator.*reminder' "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
